title: Laying The Groundwork For Unity
paragraphs: “Oh…”
When I looked ahead, I saw a group of robed men standing there, stunned.
“What the…?”
“Huh?”
“Die, you scum!”

Almost on reflex, I suspected them of unsealing the Phoenix… but dealing with them would be a hassle, so I simply ran both of them through with my spear. Someone had asked me to spare them, but honestly, letting them live would have just pissed me off. This is their punishment for making Father and the others wear such expressions. Honestly, I feel like I could kill them a dozen times over, but I’ll settle for just once. Oh, and I made sure not to hit my still-dazed Father. Now then, time to sort out the situation. As expected, choosing “No” must have triggered another loop. If that hadn’t worked, I would’ve been in serious trouble.

At worst, I could have hunted down either Itsuki or Ren and finished them off to trigger the loop… but even that wasn’t a sure thing, was it? In the loop before last, Father told me to gather information, so I followed the same course of action as in the first world. Well, I learned that Father, when not falsely accused, is actually a very kind person. The Father from the first world was kind as well, but this one possessed an even greater kindness and magnanimity. Now, onto the main issue—proceeding as in the first world: staying in Melromarc, eliminating the Three Heroes Church, and clearing Father’s false charges. This takes an incredible amount of time, and on top of that, my relationship with Itsuki completely deteriorates. To make matters worse, Éclair ends up dying in prison. If I were to rush in and save Éclair too soon, the Three Heroes Church would become wary, making it impossible to follow the original course of events. Well, I could choose to rescue Éclair after confirming that Father has grown stronger, but in the end, the outcome wouldn’t change much. At present, after summing up everything from the loops so far, there are countless sparks that could ignite into war. And even if, by some stroke of luck, we manage to avoid war, Ren and Itsuki become jealous of my and Father’s strength and end up unsealing the Spirit Tortoise or the Phoenix. Next time, I might be able to clean up the mess and make Ren and Itsuki reflect on their actions, just like in the first world, but Father said that would be far too much trouble. That’s right. It takes far too much time. As Father said, there’s no time for the Heroes to be fighting among themselves. This time, since Father asked me to test something, I plan to carry it out based on my own reasoning. What he requested was to improve the relationship between the Heroes. The key issue here is that Ren and Itsuki refuse to listen to me. Not only that, but they claim that differences in strengthening methods, weapon-specific traits, or even the idea that my strength comes from replicating NPC abilities are the reasons for their disbelief. They keep looking for excuses to denounce me and Father. However, Father has taught me a way to resolve this issue. First, I need to put that into practice.
That aside… where is Filo-tan, anyway?
Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan!
“Hey.”

A few pokes brought me back to my senses. Oh, it looks like the loop has already begun. Right in front of me, Father—who seems to still carry the lingering presence of Filo-tan—was looking at me with a suspicious expression. It seems I’ve already been escorted to the throne room. Trash is acting all high and mighty.
Should I jump at him? In my mind, my previous Father warns me. He tells me that if I hug him now, everything will be ruined.
“My name is Motoyasu Kitamura. I’m 21 years old, a university student, I say!”
“I say…?”
“Aren’t you getting a little too excited?”

Ren, as usual, tries to act cool, while Father and Itsuki nod in agreement as if to back him up. No need to panic. I’ll just go with the flow for now. From all the loops so far, I already know that making a fuss here won’t accomplish anything. The most important thing is a meticulously thought-out plan.
“I can’t exactly deny that part of me,” I say.
Last time, and the time before that, I wasn’t able to meet Filo-tan. But this time, I might. Just thinking about it makes my heart dance a little.
“Hmm… Ren, Motoyasu, and Itsuki, huh?”
“King, you forgot about me.”
“Oh, my apologies, Sir Naofumi.”

There are multiple things I need to do, but to put Father’s plan into action, I must refrain from any unnecessary actions. So, for now, I’ll overlook the fact that he deliberately didn’t say Father’s name. With that resolve, I made sure to only answer when asked and not to say anything unnatural. Soon, we were led to a room where Father and the others were grinning while examining their weapons. I should at least pretend to examine my own weapon as well. While pretending to look over my status and other details, I start thinking.

Now then, what should I do once everything falls into place? As my previous Father said, I likely won’t be able to stay in Melromarc. …Ah, Father mentioned that it should be fine to head to Faubrey. So, I should prioritize heading to Faubrey. Unfortunately, due to time constraints, I wasn’t able to get a portal from Father, but the distance isn’t impossible to cover. If things go smoothly, there will still be plenty of hardships to face.
“Hey, this feels like a game, doesn’t it?”
“This world is just like a console game.”
“No, it’s different. It’s a VRMMO.”
“Huh? VRMMO, as in Virtual Reality MMO? Isn’t that something from the future?”
“What!? What are you even talking about?”

Father and the others start explaining what happened to them and their gaming knowledge. I’ve heard this conversation countless times before. If I recall correctly, Father once said that in the beginning, the differences between loops are minimal. That’s also why it’s easier to create changes early on.
“Motoyasu, what about you?”

As expected, at this stage, Father still calls me by name without any honorifics. I used to be fine with the way he spat out my name in the first world, but lately, I’ve come to find the gentle way he calls me in other loops much more comforting. Father is the Shield Hero, a protector not only of the people but even of his fellow Heroes. And saving him is my duty.
“Me, you ask? Well, there’s an online game called Emerald Online that’s somewhat similar to this world.”

I explain things smoothly so as not to cause any unnecessary problems. If I were to reveal that I came from the future at this stage, they wouldn’t believe me anyway. Also, at this point in time, Father still had an interest in women, but because of that damn crimson swine framing him, he lost even that. It seems an older sisterly figure helped him heal, but in the previous loop… I vaguely remember a panda beast.

This is… that kind of situation, isn’t it? It seems that Father originally prefers women around his own age or slightly older. Heh, heh, heh. I’ve spent so much time with him that I’ve started to understand these things. Maybe I should try playing matchmaker for him, like my friend back in middle school used to do. If I recall correctly, affection levels are represented with heart marks. Fiancée was blatantly aiming for Father, but in that case, I just need to increase the number of heart marks. Well, Father doesn’t seem to be into younger women, though. Fiancée, despite having Filo-tan as her supposed partner, is still greedily going after Father. So, I just need to block her first. If she has someone she’s close with
“Yeah, that’s right… Hmm, sorry, everyone. I was at the library, reading a book I didn’t recognize, and before I knew it, I was here.”

Ren and Itsuki cast cold glances at Father. For me, this all feels like a distant past, but among us, Father certainly stands out when it comes to how he was summoned. No—perhaps we’re the ones in the wrong here. Thinking about it, Father was the one who truly led this world as a hero. In other words, he has the highest aptitude as a hero.
That’s not something we can just dismiss as foolishness!
“Everyone has their own circumstances. Are you trying to one-up each other in misery or something?”
“But… I mean, come on?”
“Yeah, it does seem a bit weak as a reason.”
“Do you really need such a strong reason just to be summoned? Didn’t he just explain his situation?”
“Well… yeah, but it’s still a little…”
“If we assume that everyone died, then maybe something happened at the library where Naofumi was?”
“I see, something like a terrorist attack or a natural disaster? If that were the case, it wouldn’t be strange if we died before even realizing it.”
“Ugh… Listening to you guys talk, it actually sounds plausible, which makes it even scarier…”

Oh! Ren managed to connect the conversation smoothly. This is fortunate. Ren is actually being useful for once. Still, I can’t help but feel a bit strange about Ren and Itsuki actually listening to me and Father. Given how things went last time, I suppose it can’t be helped. …In other words, back at this point in time, Ren and Itsuki were still open to discussion.
“So then, does everyone here pretty much understand the rules—or rather, the system of this world?”
“Yeah.”
“Yes, at least well enough that I don’t need to check a guide site.”
Father gives a slightly awkward smile. Seeing him always striving forward, never letting himself be defeated, he truly shines.
“H-Hey, could you teach me some things about fighting in this world? My world didn’t have any similar games.”

Ah, at this timing, I can explain things to Father. Well, given the time constraints, it would be difficult to teach him everything, so just a brief overview should suffice. If Ren and Itsuki also join in and share their knowledge, it might strengthen our “How about the terrain?” I believe I brought up this topic at some point.
“The names are different, but the landscape is almost identical. That means there’s a high chance that the distribution of efficient monster farming spots is the same as well.”
“Hunting grounds vary slightly depending on the weapon type, so let’s make sure not to go to the same places.”
“Come on, Fa—Naofumi, you should join in too!”
“U-Yeah…”

I accidentally called Father by name without an honorific. My apologies. But at least I successfully included him in the conversation. Building things up from small interactions like this is key. If we keep at it, the bond between the heroes should grow stronger.
“Alright then—”
“Heroes, your meal is ready.”

Just as we were about to continue the discussion, the castle staff cut in, as if to prevent anything that might put Father at an advantage. They must be trying to keep him from gaining useful information. We need to be patient. For now, I must be careful not to let them notice that I’m supporting Father. Thinking back to the first world I looped through, sharing enhancement methods might not be a problem, but considering that Father was killed later on, staying cautious is the best approach. Even if Ren or Itsuki die and I loop again, I will never allow a loop where Father is killed ever again. After finishing our meal, we all naturally turned in for the night. Of course, before bed, I went to visit the esteemed Filolials for a little fun.
